title: Does DINOv3 Set a New Medical Vision Standard? Benchmarking 2D and 3D Classification, Segmentation, and Registration
mechanism: Evidence paper: DINOv3 transfer across medical classification, segmentation and registration.
adaptation: Caution for VFM-H: per D14's reading, DINOv3 did not follow scaling laws in several non-natural modalities. Size (ViT-B vs ViT-L) must be measured on CV, not assumed.
min_experiment: Within the DINOv3 arm: ViT-B/16 vs ViT-L/16 on CV crack relF1@2; drop to ViT-B if L is not +0.01.
